title: rc-live-5: the Compassionate Death Allowance Benefit

turns.user: If Daniel died in an accident, is there an allowance for funeral expenses in our booklet, and what does it need?
turns.visible:
The booklet’s Compassionate Death Allowance Benefit says funeral expenses incurred are payable up to 2,000 (printed with a “$” sign; the document does not say which currency) if bodily injury from an Accident independently results in death within 365 days of the Accident, on receipt of proof of death and the original receipts; it is not payable for death caused by illness.
The booklet is reference wording.
The uploaded documents do not confirm Daniel’s enrolment in the group scheme, so they do not establish that this benefit applies to him.

passage.text:
Section 5 - Compassionate Death Allowance Benefit
If an Insured Person sustains bodily injury as a result of an Accident, which
independently of any other cause results in the Insured Person's death within 365 days of the Accident, we will
pay the funeral expenses incurred, up to $2,000, on receipt of proof of death and the original receipts.
This benefit is not payable for death caused by an illness.
Section 6 - Repatriation

support.text: pay the funeral expenses incurred, up to $2,000, on receipt of proof of death and the original receipts.

passage.text:
PART A - GROUP TERM LIFE
Death Benefit
We will pay 100% of the Sum Insured if the Insured Person dies while covered.

support.text: Death Benefit

passage.text: We will pay up to $5,000 for the cost of bringing the Insured Person's body home if death occurs overseas.

support.text: We will pay up to $5,000 for the cost of bringing the Insured Person's body home if death occurs overseas.

passage.text:
PART B - GROUP PERSONAL ACCIDENT
Section 3 - Simple Fracture
Simple Fracture means a closed fracture where the skin is not broken.
Simple Fracture Benefit Limit: S$5,000
We will pay the percentage of the Simple Fracture Benefit Limit shown below for a Simple Fracture of a nature listed, caused by an Accident.
